name: Dharshini K
wishText: Some connections begin as strangers… grow into friends… and become quietly special.
textInChatBox: We were once unknown to each other. Then we became friends. Somewhere along the way, you became someone truly special to me.
text2: I wasn’t sure how to say this...
text5Content: I just want you to know — from unknown to friend to someone special — I’m grateful for you.
outroText: No pressure, no expectations… just a genuine wish from the heart.
replayText: Click again if you want to feel it once more.
